Student learning paths

A starting point
for every stage.

Live guidance, practical projects and presentation confidence, with a path suited to your current level.

Discuss a student path↗
  1. 01
    Grade 3-5

    Block Coding & App Starter

    Scratch Jr, Scratch, app building, logic, games, puzzles and digital creativity.

  2. 02
    Grade 6-8

    Python, JavaScript & Apps

    Python basics, JavaScript, mini websites, app building, games and project demos.

  3. 03
    Grade 9-12

    AI, Web Apps & Languages

    Python, JavaScript, C, C++, Java, AI chatbots, APIs, apps and demo day.

  4. 04
    College

    Internship & Career Lab

    C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, FYP, GitHub, resume, mock interview and career project support.

product development
internships.

The work you take forward

More than
attendance.

Working products, portfolio stories, mentor review and final-demo confidence. Credentials depend on the track, attendance, work quality, project completion and mentor review.

Credentials students can earn

  • Internship Completion Certificate
  • Live Project Certificate
  • Mentor Performance Report
  • Portfolio Completion Badge
  • Letter of Recommendation for top performers
  • GitHub Portfolio Verification

Optional career support

Focused mentoring can be added when you need deeper support.

  • 1-on-1 career mentoring
  • Resume review
  • LinkedIn profile optimization
  • Mock technical interviews
  • Placement assistance
  • Freelancing guidance
  • Startup incubation support
Campus & project opportunities

Find the role
that fits you.

Start with a practical responsibility, demonstrate consistency and grow through work you can show.

Explore a role with Tivoro↗
Campus Ambassador

Become the Tivoro voice in your college.

For students who enjoy networking, leadership and helping classmates discover courses, internships and AI learning paths.

Best for: confident communicators

Student Growth Partner

Generate genuine student enquiries.

Share programs with the right audience, explain the value clearly and earn through verified enrollments or qualified leads.

Best for: outreach and sales learners

Workshop Coordinator

Bring AI and coding sessions to campus.

Coordinate mini workshops, demo sessions, awareness talks and student groups with support from Tivoro mentors.

Best for: organizers and college connectors

Content Creator Intern

Create reels, posters and student stories.

Build content around AI, coding, career confusion, college projects, student wins and Tivoro events.

Best for: creators and designers

Tech Project Intern

Work on websites, AI tools and automation.

Selected students can assist on real client projects, landing pages, dashboards, chatbots and internal tools.

Best for: builders and coders

Business Development Intern

Learn client conversations with empathy.

Understand business needs, explain website and automation options, and learn how digital services are sold responsibly.

Best for: future entrepreneurs

How a student grows

From learning
to building
to leading.

01

Enter with intent

Choose whether you want product work, campus leadership, content, growth, business development or career support.

02

Build with mentors

Work through practical tasks, product thinking, project reviews, communication and deployment habits.

03

Show proof

Create a portfolio asset: live project, GitHub proof, campaign report, workshop result or ambassador mission.

04

Present confidently

Learn to explain the problem, your role, what you built, what changed and what you learned.

05

Move higher

Top performers can grow into paid project support, college captain, city lead or deeper career accelerator tracks.

Performance-based opportunities

Genuine value.
Meaningful outcomes.

Tivoro does not support pressure selling. Rewards relate to verified referrals, workshops, business leads and completed growth missions.

  1. Level 1

    Student referrals

    Earn rewards when a verified student joins a course, workshop, internship or project program.

  2. Level 2

    Workshop registrations

    Coordinate college sessions and earn performance rewards for genuine registrations.

  3. Level 3

    Business leads

    Refer schools, colleges, salons, stores, creators or startups that need websites, leads or automation.

  4. Level 4

    Leadership bonus

    Top performers can become College Captain, City Lead or paid project interns.
